scientific_question: After a traceable surface NH4-N aqueous pool dries to loss of explicit aqueous storage, does the retained continuation pool transfer completely to surface aqueous NH4-N when explicit surface water returns, and can that transfer be distinguished from slower release or direct alternative-receiver behavior?
candidate_prediction: When explicit positive surface aqueous storage is re-established, the retained continuation pool transfers completely to SURFACE_AQUEOUS_NH4_STORAGE before downstream runoff, infiltration, sorption-after-arrival, transformation or atmospheric loss consume that aqueous NH4-N.
operational_instantaneous_rule: Instantaneous is evaluated at the predeclared earliest defensible sampling resolution; SQ11 sets no universal time threshold.
ordering_rule: Observed soil/mineral uptake or atmospheric loss after complete aqueous arrival is compatible with M1 and must not be misclassified as evidence against the continuation-to-aqueous transfer itself.

competing_hypotheses.H_PARTIAL: Only part of the continuation pool reaches surface aqueous NH4-N at first resolvable activation while a non-aqueous residue remains.
competing_hypotheses.H_DELAYED: Aqueous NH4-N attributable to the retained pool continues to increase after first resolvable activation because release is finite-rate or delayed.
competing_hypotheses.H_DIRECT_ALTERNATIVE_RECEIVER: A material fraction reaches a soil/mineral or other receiver without evidence of prior surface-aqueous arrival, when the experimental resolution can actually distinguish that ordering.
competing_hypotheses.H_OTHER_RETAINED: A material fraction remains non-aqueous after rewetting.

stage_A.name: ISOLATED_INERT_SURFACE_PRIMARY_TRANSFER_TEST
stage_A.purpose: Primary test of the continuation-to-aqueous transfer while suppressing or tightly bounding downstream receiver ambiguity.
required: traceable NH4-N source and counter-ion composition
inert mass-accountable vessel
pre-dry aqueous NH4-N mass
documented dry endpoint with no explicit aqueous storage
dry-down atmospheric loss measured or tightly bounded
residue material/phase characterization
predeclared rewetting water amount and composition
earliest technically defensible aqueous NH4-N measurement after water return
time-resolved aqueous NH4-N after rewetting
terminal retained/non-aqueous N
rewetting downstream losses suppressed where feasible or measured sufficiently to reconstruct aqueous arrival
full N mass closure with uncertainty

stage_B.name: SURFACE_SOIL_OR_MINERAL_ORDERING_AND_FATE_TEST
stage_B.purpose: Test lifecycle ordering and downstream fate under representative contact; downstream uptake after aqueous arrival is not itself a refutation of M1.
required: same source and dry-down bookkeeping as Stage A
defined soil/mineral matrix
sufficient temporal resolution to assess whether aqueous arrival precedes downstream transfer
time-resolved surface aqueous NH4-N
quantified soil/mineral NH4-N receiver
atmospheric loss measured or tightly bounded
terminal retained/non-aqueous N where separable
full N mass closure with uncertainty

tracer.reason: Improves attribution against background N, especially in Stage B and atmospheric-loss accounting.

experimental_architecture.replication_rule: The executing laboratory must predeclare replication/randomization from pilot variance, analytical precision and power target. SQ11 has no evidence basis for a universal numeric n.

derived_quantities.f_delayed_increment: source-attributable increase in aqueous NH4-N after t_first divided by M_dry_retained_total_N
derived_quantities.f_direct_alternative_receiver: source-attributable alternative-receiver N proven not to have passed through the surface-aqueous receiver divided by M_dry_retained_total_N

decision_rules.uncertainty: Use predeclared combined measurement uncertainty and method quantification limits; no arbitrary universal epsilon is introduced.
support_M1_for_tested_condition: Stage A first-resolvable source-attributable aqueous recovery is compatible with complete transfer after accounting for any measured downstream loss occurring before sampling
no material delayed release from the continuation residue is observed
terminal non-aqueous retained N is absent or bounded within the declared uncertainty/quantification envelope
mass closure passes the predeclared analytical criterion
material characterization supports a traceable mapping for the tested residue
refute_M1_for_tested_condition: material non-aqueous residue remains after rewetting under a closed mass balance
source-attributable aqueous recovery materially increases after the first resolvable activation in a manner attributable to delayed release from the continuation pool
a direct alternative receiver is demonstrated with temporal/source evidence sufficient to exclude prior surface-aqueous arrival
first-resolvable aqueous arrival plus any independently quantified downstream transfer that occurred before sampling remains materially below the retained continuation mass
compatible_but_not_discriminating_agains: soil/mineral uptake after demonstrated surface-aqueous arrival
atmospheric loss after demonstrated surface-aqueous arrival
runoff, infiltration, sorption or transformation after demonstrated surface-aqueous arrival
inconclusive: sampling too coarse to distinguish complete transfer followed by downstream loss from direct alternative transfer or finite-rate release
an unmeasured downstream pathway cannot be tightly bounded
decision_rules.scope_limit: A pass supports only the tested material and application envelope and cannot by itself establish a universal ANIMO constitutive law.

evidence_package.raw_data: immutable raw observations or governance-approved immutable external reference
evidence_package.provenance: sample lineage, lab/operator identity, dates and source-material traceability
evidence_package.uncertainty: reported for measurements and derived fractions
evidence_package.negative_results: retained; failed/inconclusive runs may not be silently excluded
